## Project outputs

Papers and talks will be linked here as they become available. The project
plans:

- Two articles in philosophy of science
- One article in science and technology studies (STS)
- A perspective piece for climate scientists
- A public-facing article for a general audience
- A report or proceedings from the [workshop](workshop.qmd)
- Symposia at the Philosophy of Science Association and Society for Social
  Studies of Science meetings
